events.headline: Burkina Faso restores military parade for national day
events.summary: The government of Burkina Faso announced a large military parade in Ouagadougou on December 11 to celebrate the national day. Authorities under Captain Ibrahim Traoré aim to emphasize national sovereignty and honor the armed forces in this first parade of its kind since 2020.
events.whyItMatters: The revived ceremony serves to display military modernization and foster unity and patriotism across the country.

events.headline: Dublin primary school teacher crowned Miss Ireland 2026
events.summary: Iris Ruddy, a 26-year-old primary school teacher and professional dancer from Dublin, was crowned Miss Ireland 2026 in Dundalk. She will now represent Ireland at the Miss World 2027 competition in Tanzania.
events.whyItMatters: The event brought together finalists, former titleholders, and guests while raising funds and awareness for chosen charities.
